data.one_liner: Load and cache any asset type with a custom decoder
data.what_it_does: asset_cache provides generic and typed caches for binary, image, json, and text assets. It stores decoded objects in memory and offers cache management and preloading.
use_when: You need fast repeated access to local assets
You want a simple in-memory cache without external dependencies
You need custom decoding logic for assets
avoid_when: You require persistent storage across app restarts
You need disk caching or eviction policies
You are already using a full-featured asset bundle manager
strengths: Zero external dependencies beyond flutter and path
Built-in support for common asset types
weaknesses: No eviction strategy for large caches
Limited to assets bundled with the app
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, declare assets in pubspec, create cache instance
data.minimal_example:
final imageCache = ImageAssetCache(basePath: "assets/images/");
final image = await imageCache.load('sprite.png');
